question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Have'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• Have- Used with pronoun in the sense of having something in present form; to possess.
 
• Will have- Used when we are looking back from a point in time in the future.
 
• Had- Used in the sense of having something in past form; to possess.
 
• Has- Used with present perfect tense sentences when the subject is singular; to possess
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 1 is 'have'.
 
• Thus, 'option 1' is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: *All elephants have several distinctive features, the most notable of which is a long trunk or proboscis, used for many purposes particularly breathing, lifting water and grasping objects.*
